title: Miso-Glazed Fish Fillet with Cacio e Pepe Crunch
description: A modern fusion of Japanese and Italian flavors, featuring a crispy cacio e pepe crust on top of a pan-seared fish fillet, finished with a sweet and savory miso glaze.

ingredients.name: Fish Fillet
ingredients.notes: Any firm white fish works well

ingredients.name: Molten Cacio e Pepe
ingredients.notes: see below for cacio e pepe recipe

ingredients.name: Miso Paste
ingredients.notes: white or yellow miso works well

instructions: Season the fish fillet with garlicky Italian seasoning.
Dip the fish fillet in breadcrumbs, pressing gently to coat.
Heat a skillet over medium-high heat and sear the fish for 2-3 minutes on each side, until golden brown.
Transfer the skillet to the preheated oven and bake for 8-10 minutes, until cooked through.
While the fish is baking, mix miso paste with a small amount of water to create a glaze.
Remove the skillet from the oven and brush the miso glaze over the top of the fish.
Return the skillet to the oven and bake for an additional 2-3 minutes, until the glaze is caramelized.
Remove the fish from the oven and top with a spoonful of molten cacio e pepe.
